title: Selected physical AC1021 MATERIAL graph output and readback
scope: Qualify the three MATERIAL records rooted at ACAD_MATERIAL in one existing AC1021 source for same-version ASCII and Binary DXF output, exact typed/common-link readback, extension-dictionary and XRECORD closure, atomic mutation refusal, and same-adapter retry.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local drawing; author and producer are not independently authenticated. No DWG/DXF fixture or derivative is committed.

sourceGraph.root: The NOD contains one ACAD_MATERIAL edge to dictionary 0x6A.
sourceGraph.materials: Dictionary 0x6A contains exactly three unique keys: ByBlock to MATERIAL 0xED, ByLayer to 0xEC, and Global to 0xEE. Each typed MATERIAL has owner and sole reactor 0x6A, a complete decoded fixed nonprocedural body, and a unique raw AC1021 source frame.
sourceGraph.extensionDictionaries: The three MATERIAL records own extension dictionaries 0x1F9, 0x1F7, and 0x173. Those dictionaries contain seven XRECORD targets in total: 0x1FA, 0x1F8, 0x175, 0x174, 0x1FB, 0x176, and 0x177.
sourceGraph.projection: The adapter test selects only ACAD_MATERIAL, its owner dictionary, all three MATERIAL records, their extension dictionaries, and the seven XRECORDs. Other source objects and unrelated named-resource receipts are excluded from this output projection.

files.dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp: The unchanged-source MATERIAL gate now admits the bounded AC1021 raw-source profile alongside AC1024/AC1027, and nonempty imported DWG MATERIAL collections request NOD-rooted extension-graph emission.
files.tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp: The physical MATERIAL output selector now supports an AC1021 selected projection. It checks all three material bodies/common links and owner keys, all extension-dictionary edges, all seven emitted XRECORD identities, mapped owners, payloads, and atomic mutation/owner-key refusal with destination preservation and same-adapter retry. The existing AC1024 full-source selector remains covered.

ac1021SelectedGraph.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary output and fresh readback; 3 MATERIAL identities, dictionary keys, typed bodies, owner/reactor roles, 3 extension dictionaries, and 7 exact XRECORD payloads are checked. Late MATERIAL mutation and invalid owner-key alias/missing-key states refuse without replacing the destination sentinel; restoring the source allows retry with the same adapter.

ac1024Regression.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary output and fresh readback, including atomic refusal and same-adapter retry.

limits: This is one selected graph from one local AC1021 source and does not qualify whole-source output, another producer, or other AC1021 graph shapes.

Where the source DWG does not retain a DXF dictionary edge-code annotation, the control verifies ordered keys, mapped targets, ownership, and reactors but does not claim independent proof that the writer's emitted 350/360 edge code matches producer intent.
Native material rendering/semantics, consumer acceptance, other material procedures/tails, and support claims remain unqualified.
The AC1021 whole-source export remains blocked by independent document-wide gates, including DBCOLOR and other unqualified source frames.
nextAction: Continue with another independently bounded AC1021 source graph or standard-object family from the current frame inventory; retain strict whole-source refusal until all document dependencies close.
